headline: storage_encrypted is immutable on existing RDS instances; this change will fail to apply

findings.evidence_ref: diff shows storage_encrypted: false → true on existing aws_db_instance.main resource
findings.explanation: AWS RDS does not permit in-place modification of storage_encrypted on existing instances. Terraform will fail to apply this change. Enabling encryption on an unencrypted database requires creating a new instance and migrating data.
